notes.title: Broken Shell is the cutest looking love story adventure of two little hermit crabs
notes.notes:
You ever look at a game and just think - "wow, this looks truly lovely"? That's the feeling I got from seeing Broken Shell and I can't wait to see it release.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/02/broken-shell-is-the-cutest-looking-love-story-adventure-of-two-little-hermit-crabs/

notes.title: Broken Shell at Wholesome Steam Celebration!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041021/3f0bc4423ed4367f7cae9dc0823b215aa0883626.jpg[/img]

Claw Friends! We're excited to announce that Broken Shell is featured in the Wholesome Steam Celebration! Curated by Wholesome Games along with a collection of cozy and wholesome titles, Broken Shell is a about a cute couple searching for a new home in a very emotional tale.

The demo for Broken Shell is available now, so please take a look during the festival, and be sure to wishlist the game below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018500/Broken_Shell/
